Fundamental limits of hot-carrier and photothermal plasmonic solar chemistry
item.description: arXiv:2608.08492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasmonic catalysts convert sunlight through direct metal--adsorbate excitation, nonequilibrium hot carriers and photothermal heating, yet these channels lack a common efficiency limit analogous to the Shockley-Queisser (SQ) limit. Here, we formulate a channel-resolved detailed-balance theory for plasmonic solar chemistry.
